issue.title: Fix verse-audio FormData upload and Record CR leftovers
issue.body:
## Summary

Recording uploads failed with Expo winter fetch FormData errors (`Unsupported FormDataPart`, then RN `ArrayBufferView` Blob rejection). Also address actionable CodeRabbit leftovers from #237.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Verse-audio multipart upload uses Expo-compatible bytes FormData parts (not `{ uri }` / ArrayBufferView Blob)
- [ ] Device upload reaches the API (no FormData client errors); 404 from undeployed verse-audio routes is expected until fluent-api #224 lands
- [ ] Sync / system back gated while recording is active
- [ ] Pause then play same take resumes without resetting to 0:00
- [ ] Remove unused iOS-only `microphonePermission` from app.config
- [ ] Unit tests cover FormData / playback resume paths

## Links

Related: #238, #237, #236, #100, #102
